pages.title: Mutation
pages.text: Mutation is the process of transforming natural blocks into new forms using Mutavis. Through it, hidden aspects of the world are revealed, allowing common materials to take on magical properties.

pages.title: Using Mutavis
pages.text: Mutavis can be applied directly to blocks to trigger a transformation. The result depends on the material, often revealing new plants, altered terrain, or unexpected resources.

pages.title: Area Mutation
pages.text: When used on a $(l:hexalia:content/enchanted_plants#morphora)Morphora$(/l), Mutavis spreads outward, affecting nearby blocks at once. This allows large-scale transformation of the surrounding environment.

pages.title: On Results
pages.text: Mutations may either replace the original block or produce their result as an item. This behavior can be configured, allowing different approaches to resource gathering.

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: Mutavis can be applied using dispensers, enabling automated mutation of blocks or Morphora flowers when supplied with the necessary resources.

pages.title: On Discovery
pages.text: Different materials respond differently to Mutavis. Plants, stone, and earth each reveal their own transformations, encouraging experimentation across the natural world.
